records.finding: Historical structural-overlay admin browser workflow runs on push main and workflow_dispatch only, omitting pull_request checks and auth/RBAC/access-policy path triggers. It also lacks isolated CE_ADMIN_E2E_FIXTURE=true test configuration. Blind restoration would weaken pre-merge administrative/subscriber access regression coverage and bypass role fixtures; do not import.
records.required_next_evidence: Independent reviewer verifies PR event path coverage and least-privilege permissions, negative role tests in disposable PGLite, fixture never enabled outside CI, and real browser test for admin/subscriber isolation before any functional approval.

records.finding: Historical diagnostic job requires .vercel/output/static/index.html after build; canonical job verifies Nitro SSR manifest and __server.func. Restoring historical workflow would reintroduce static-only checks that missed deploy failures.
records.required_next_evidence: Independent review and Vercel READY preview of Nitro Build Output API v3; do not interpret local build gate as deployed SSR.

records.finding: Historical verifier lacks source-intake/Git-provenance gates, simulates exclusions before all evidence checks and expects static index.html; canonical workflow performs provenance checks before exclusions and candidate PR89 adds real OPA and P0 gates.
records.required_next_evidence: Reviewer validates immutable intake hashes, testing sequence, OPA binary pin, HTTP signatures and no bypass of clinical release conditions.

records.finding: Historical Zod experiment expects index.html, whereas canonical check requires Nitro manifest and SSR function. Neither version is evidence that a Zod package update is safe without exact lockfile and security audit.
records.required_next_evidence: Re-run npm audit with a reviewed exact Zod version/lockfile, SSR preview readiness and independent supply-chain approval before replacing any dependency or workflow.

records.finding: Historical migrator exits with REMOTE_INTEGRATION_BLOCKED (exit 4) before DATABASE_URL access, despite comments describing automatic deployment. Canonical migrator requires CE_DB_MIGRATION_APPROVED=true plus --approved and forbids CI; historical backup must not replace it.
records.required_next_evidence: Independent control-flow and negative gate tests; PostgreSQL 17 disposable idempotence and rollback; verify root-only migration scope, authorization, and no managed auth DDL.

records.finding: Legacy enables authentication unless VITE_AUTH_ENABLED is exactly false and uses genericOAuthClient/signIn.oauth2; canonical requires explicit true and uses social sign-in. Blind replacement could re-enable auth or alter provider contract.
records.required_next_evidence: Browser and server tests of disabled/undefined/true flags and provider-specific OAuth flow, verified credentials and 401/403 negative cases.

records.finding: Canonical test has before/after hooks forcing positive auth scenario and restoring environment, unlike old version; historical copy would lose isolated positive coverage when CI sets VITE_AUTH_ENABLED=false.
records.required_next_evidence: Verify execution of negative auth-off and positive identity tests under CI, independently audit JWT issuer/audience and session binding.

records.finding: Historical preview source embeds a literal client credential. Canonical code retrieves GROK_PREVIEW_CLIENT_SECRET from the server environment; Git history must be treated as exposed independently of source cleanup. Never reproduce the credential in evidence.
records.required_next_evidence: Confirm credential rotation/revocation by its owner using nonsecret confirmation and verify OAuth preview callback under approved environment, issue #28.

records.finding: Git textual diff is limited to a provider callback path comment: old oauth2/callback vs current callback. No executable statement difference observed in this pair; callback compatibility still requires E2E.
records.required_next_evidence: Verify configured provider names, callback path, signed OAuth state, redirect allowlist and user roles against live preview, without publishing credentials.

records.finding: Historical auth server only disables providers when VITE_AUTH_ENABLED equals false, so an unset or other value does not enforce the canonical explicit opt-in; if provider credentials are present this can expose sign-in in unintended environments. Historical localStorage-only backup also skips ensureDbReady(); canonical requires exactly true and initializes database. Never restore this file blindly.
records.required_next_evidence: Independent security reviewer verifies true/false/unset and malformed flag cases, provider credential sourcing, session persistence/isolation, 401/403 denials, database initialization and failure behavior, and test fixture off in production; run isolated browser/server tests before approval.

records.finding: Canonical code allows a shared development identity only when NODE_ENV=development, no VERCEL/VERCEL_ENV and no configured database; old version could fall back to a dev identity on hosted auth-off sessions without DATABASE_URL.
records.required_next_evidence: Negative tests on Vercel with absent DATABASE_URL, auth-off, missing session and cross-user access, plus preview SSR smoke and real session isolation.
